# Site Map {.unnumbered}

This page lists **every document on the site in one place** — the same
structure as the left-hand sidebar of each section, flattened into a
single scrollable index so you can scan or search (`Ctrl`/`Cmd`+`F`) the
whole corpus at once instead of expanding one sidebar pane at a time.

Use the page contents (right) to jump between sections, or browse the
nested tree below. Each entry links to the rendered page.

::: {.callout-note}
This tree is **generated from the site navigation** in
[`docs/_quarto.yml`](_quarto.yml) by
[`scripts/generate_sitemap.py`](../scripts/generate_sitemap.py) and
cannot drift from the sidebar — the `sitemap-drift` CI workflow
regenerates it on every PR and fails if the committed copy is stale. To
refresh after changing the navigation:

```bash
python scripts/generate_sitemap.py --output docs/data/sitemap-tree.md
```
:::
